limitations: All final windows have previously been inspected; exploratory paired ablation, not a fresh independent-data holdout.
NDC difficulty cohort was label-informed; retain full6000 inference context and evaluate fixed1750 subset.
Residual Dual RW means its actual two-step walk statistics, not a learned embedding.
Residual MLSHoL main has RW off; RW on adds a trained64D past-only candidate-graph SGNS branch, authorized by the user.

MRNL is K2 TRNL scalar input; all representation methods dimension1 to preserve controls. LINE uses second-order objective. Fixed existing history/strength branches are preserved equally; no additional activity feature is introduced.
Genuine Struc2vec not bundled; skip explicitly, never run old KNN substitute.
Eu/Ubuntu causal RW repairs can change older single-seed numeric references; no test-driven correction permitted.
